quotes: failures.check(secret not in line.lower(), f"_transport_log_record leaked {secret!r}: {line!r}")
verdicts.why: The installed guard is exercised and required to refuse untrusted-host and oversized-body requests. The logging check is weaker than TRN-003: it tests one synthetic record made only from non-secret inputs for a short list of forbidden words, without injecting credential or cookie values or inspecting actual emitted log lines.
